results_that_do_not_follow.reason: The roadmap entry says the audit 'found no attempt the bound would change' and default bits are safe, but amendment 1 (lines 281-290) shows the bound did change a default-path outcome (NC1 refused before, accepted now); the audit never saw that test.

Decision 'done' lists B3 as met, but B3 was measured on the pre-merge base and not re-run (lines 236, 258), and a default-path behaviour then changed (NC1, line 359); the registered rule (line 194) says a changed default makes the item todo, and NC1 was made an ignored record to reach 'no failure' in M1 (line 353).

NC1b is reported 'met' on '20 iterations (= max_iterations)', but the test file never asserts rep.iterations (see the test file line 173-177), so the claim that the bound at the last iterate accepted the step is not verified by the check.

checks_that_cannot_fail.reason: The 'accepted at the last iterate' check compares opts.newton.max_iterations with max_iterations, which was copied from the same field at line 159; it is always true and never looks at rep.iterations.

limits_that_test_nothing.reason: A2 limit 1e-9 against a measured 3.56e-18 (and an estimated ~3e-17): eight or more orders of slack, so a wrong accepted solution would still pass.
P1 limit 'total halvings <= 19' against 0 measured, and period <= 1e-2 / energy <= 1e-3 against 2.1e-4 / 2.8e-4, are loose enough to pass a markedly worse computation.
A1 momentum limit 1e-11 against measured 1.297e-14: three orders of slack on a quantity that should be at rounding level.
NC1b upper limit 1e-7 against the recorded 1.392e-10 is three orders loose; it only excludes gross failure of the bound branch.
